title: bash
description: Input schema for the lernie built-in `bash` tool (ARCH §3.3, §12 v0.3 toolset). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

command.description: Shell command to execute via `sh -c`. The string is passed verbatim; quoting and escaping are the shell's job. Stdout becomes the tool result; stderr is concatenated after stdout when the command exits non-zero (ARCH §3.3 stdio contract).
